headline: Roosevelt unbeaten and scoring like no one else
dek: Roosevelt have scored twelve goals and conceded five without losing, more than Davenport, Purdue Northwest and Wisconsin-Parkside have managed between them. Only Purdue Northwest and Saginaw Valley State have otherwise gone unbeaten, and no member has yet met another.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Purdue Northwest have scored only three goals and are unbeaten on the back of a single goal conceded. The shape of the chart is not the shape of the records: what a side allows has mattered more than what it scores.

wire.line: Davenport have conceded ten goals already, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches whose dates have passed carry no published result, and there are no score gaps: every final on the record has its score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Six played matches carry a result but no box score, every one of them Roosevelt's or St. Cloud State's.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Estefano Alvear has conceded a single goal for Purdue Northwest and kept two shutouts, a save percentage of .923.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Saginaw Valley State have spread six goals across five different scorers.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Roosevelt's four wins are more than any other programme has managed.

last_match.line: Northern Michigan's only defeat came at Tiffin, where Saginaw Valley State have since drawn.

next_match.line: Roosevelt have yet to lose; Lake Erie arrive from defeat at Northern Michigan.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
